entities.name: Hasegawa Kaitarō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kaitarō Hasegawa  was a Japanese novelist and translator during the early Shōwa period. Hasegawa wrote works in various genres under numerous pen names, each with a unique personality, and caused a sensation with the sheer brilliance of his fiction, non-fiction and translations.
